fit: olive leaf extract placebo pilot outside Parkinson disease
assessment: Nineteen women with excess weight completed the three-month olive-leaf-extract pilot (nine extract and ten placebo). Symptoms improved on several within-arm measures in both groups. No participant population with Parkinson disease was studied.
